newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Acceptance to restructure debt.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Acceptance to restructure debt.

text.p: Reliance Acceptance Group Inc said Thursday that it will not generate significant new business volume for its own portfolio until it restructures its debt.
In July, Reliance reached an agreement with its bank lenders to extend its $250 million loan facility until December 15, 1997 and received a waiver of all prior defaults. Under
the terms of the extension, the amount of the facility is reduced by $10 million each month to $200 million, the company said.
Reliance said it intends to restructure its debt prior to expiration of the facility and raise additional cash through securitizations, loan sales or other transactions.
Until such restructuring occurs, Reliance will continue to reduce its base of finance receivables in order to meet the terms of its credit line, it said.
